title: Applying an action on one work tape
statement: Let $x$ be a binary input, let the set of control labels be finite, and consider a configuration with an arbitrary control state, input-head position $p$, work tapes $T_i:\mathbb{Z}\to\{0,1,\text{blank}	ext{ as an absent symbol}\}$, work-head positions $h_i\in\mathbb{Z}$, and output word $w$. For a work-tape index $t$, input-head move $i$, optional write instruction $\omega$, work-head move $m$, optional output bit $o$, and optional next state $q$, applying the action that performs these operations only on tape $t$ gives state $q$, input position the clamped move of $p$ by $i$, tape $t$ written at $h_t$ according to $\omega$ (or unchanged if there is no write), and head position $h_t+m$. Every other tape and head is unchanged, and the output is $w$ followed by $o$ when present.
hypotheses_covered: A finite set of control labels
An optional write instruction, including writing a symbol or blank
replaced:
Let $x$ be an input bit string and consider a configuration on $x$, with $R$ work tapes and the
compiled control states, having an arbitrary state, input-head position $p$, work tapes $(T_i)$,
work heads $(h_i)$ and output $w$. Applying to it the action on the single work tape $t$ with
input-head move $i$, write instruction $\omega$, head move $m$, optional output bit $o$ and
optional next state $q$ yields the configuration with state $q$, input-head position the clamped
move of $p$ by $i$, tape $t$ replaced by $T_t$ with cell $h_t$ overwritten as prescribed by
$\omega$ (and unchanged if $\omega$ writes nothing), head $t$ moved to $h_t + m$, all other
tapes and heads unchanged, and output $w$ followed by $o$ if $o$ is present.
